story.title: Hurricane Trudy Approaches Mexico's Pacific Coast with Heavy Rain Threat

timeline_highlights.title: Nor’easter Floods Northeast, Leaving Over 100,000 Without Power
timeline_highlights.summary: A powerful nor’easter has caused significant flooding across the Northeast, leaving over 100,000 people without power. The storm, which is expected to continue through Sunday, has brought heavy rain, strong winds, and dangerous surf conditions from New Jersey to New England. Tragically, a New York City housing authority worker was killed when a tree fell during the storm.

related_stories.title: Three Men Sentenced to 158 Years for Murdering Surfers in Mexico
related_stories.summary: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men to 158 years and nine months in prison each for the murders of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their American friend Carter Rhoad. The trio was killed during a surfing trip in Baja California in 2024, reportedly during an attempted robbery.

related_stories.title: Katie Zacharia Leaves White House Press Secretary Role After Just Five Days
related_stories.summary: Katie Zacharia has exited her position as White House press secretary after only five days, stating it was an honor to serve. Reports indicate she was let go following public scrutiny and a series of blunders that distracted from President Trump's midterm campaigning efforts.

related_stories.title: Zelenskyy Calls for U.S. Sanctions on Russia After Trump Pauses Them
related_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged supporters to advocate for new U.S. sanctions against Russia, following President Donald Trump's decision to pause a package of sanctions aimed at the Russian economy. Trump's executive order, which he justified as being in the national interest, marks a significant shift in U.S. policy towards Russia amid deteriorating relations with Ukraine.

related_stories.title: Children Bear Heavy Toll in DRC's Severe Ebola Outbreak
related_stories.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its deadliest Ebola outbreak, with children particularly affected. Reports indicate that more than 1 in 4 of the deaths are among children, who face a staggering 60% fatality rate. This outbreak is caused by a rare strain of the virus for which there is currently no approved treatment.
